statements.t: On October 8 2026, CSL announced that it expects to complete the rollout of Haemonetics’ devices and disposables under the supply agreement by the end of calendar year 2027, and CSL has informed us that it currently anticipates that the transition to Haemonetics devices and disposables will occur at all of CSL’s current U.S. plasma collection centers.

• The potential that the expected strategic benefits and opportunities from completed or planned acquisitions, including our acquisitions of Vivasure, OpSens Inc. and Advanced Cooling Therapy, Inc., d/b/a Attune Medical (“Attune Medical”), divestitures or other strategic investments by us may not be realized or may take longer to realize than expected;
• Our ability to obtain the anticipated benefits of restructuring programs that we have or may undertake, including our market and regional alignment initiative;
• Our ability to execute and realize anticipated benefits from our investments in emerging economies;
The Company updated its previous fiscal 2027 guidance as follows:
Management uses non-GAAP measures to monitor the financial performance of the business, make informed business decisions, establish budgets and forecast future results.
Performance targets for management are also based on certain non-GAAP financial measures.

The Company does not attempt to provide reconciliations of forward-looking adjusted operating margin guidance, adjusted earnings per diluted share guidance or free cash flow conversion guidance to the comparable GAAP measures because the combined impact and timing of recognition of certain potential charges or gains, such as restructuring costs, impairment charges and capital expenditures, is inherently uncertain…
